text:
Priya: Heads up — kicking off a lattice rollout for the model-serving config change tomorrow 2024-11-14 10:00 PDT. This is a gradual/percent ramp (non-incident). Need: deploy owner, smoke lead, rollback owner, and final cohort selection. Proposed ramp: 0 -> 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 50% (30m hold per step).

Jake: I can take deploy owner. I'll be in the deploy channel and on-call for the window.

Maria: Happy to run smoke checks. Plan to validate latency, error-rate, and a couple of deterministic prompts. Will post smoke script + sample payloads before handoff.

Priya: Awesome — assigning: Jake (deploy), Maria (smoke), Liam (rollback). Liam?

Liam: I can own rollback. I'll have the backout PR + infra revert playbook ready. Will also stage a fail-close traffic rule if we need rapid cutover.

Priya: Thanks. Quick cohort selection: starting cohort will be internal beta (team emails + 5% external low-traffic region). After 1% stable, expand to 5% across NA-east + EU-west test regions, then 20% global excluding APAC. Thoughts?

Jake: Sounds good. Suggest making the 1% entirely routed to our infra pool with extra logging. Also enable request sampling at 10x for first two steps.

Maria: For smoke, I'll run the following checks at each step: 
- curl health endpoint 
- sample generation correctness for 10 prompts
- 95th latency under baseline + 200ms
- error-rate < 0.5%
I'll share a small script: 
```bash
# smoke example
curl -s -X POST https://redwood/api/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -d '{"model":"my-model","prompt":"health check"}' | jq .
```

Priya: Good checklist. Add a quick token-cost sanity check too (no sudden token explosion).

DeployBot: preflight checks: infra quotas OK, models available on pool-eta 8m, canary route created. :white_check_mark:

Priya: Cool. Jake, can you coordinate the rollout schedule (minute-level) and post the traffic config snippet you will apply? Put it in the deploy channel and tag me.

Jake: Will do. Draft traffic config: 
```json
{
  "steps": [
    {"percent": 1, "duration_min": 30, "regions": ["internal"]},
    {"percent": 5, "duration_min": 30, "regions": ["na-east","eu-west"]},
    {"percent": 20, "duration_min": 30, "regions": ["na-east","eu-west"]},
    {"percent": 50, "duration_min": 30, "regions": ["global"]}
  ],
  "sampling_rate": 10
}
```
I'll post this as a deploy snippet in #eng-releases and pin it.

Priya: Perfect. SRE Oncall — can you be on standby for the window? If we see infra-level anomalies we may need a quick capacity flip.

SRE Oncall: On it. I'll be reachable and will monitor cluster autoscale and GPU health dashboards. If anything looks off, I will advise immediate pause + rollback.

Maria: One more thing — add an eval prompt set that checks hallucination regression for the feature. I have 12 prompts that surface the recent edge case. I'll upload to the shared drive and link in the smoke checklist.

Priya: Excellent. Timeline summary I'll post in morning: 
- 09:40 PDT — final preflight & infra checks
- 09:50 PDT — smoke scripts uploaded + small rehearsal
- 10:00 PDT — deploy start (0% -> 1%)
- 10:30 PDT — evaluate & decide to ramp to 5%
- 11:00 PDT — evaluate & decide to ramp to 20%
- 11:30 PDT — evaluate & decide to ramp to 50%

Jake: I'll also set a 10-minute manual hold between steps as a safety net. If any required metric crosses threshold we'll stop and call rollback.

Liam: Rollback readiness: backout PR #4727 pre-approved, infra revert route ready (route id: r-8462), and we tested the revert in staging yesterday.

Priya: Great. If anyone spots a red flag in the preflight please @channel immediately. Otherwise I'll post the final schedule in the morning and assign calendar invites. Thanks all. :rocket:
